recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, high-contrast portrait of a man in casual workwear, leaning against a dark, horizontally-slatted wooden wall. The lighting is directional, casting deep shadows on the left side of the frame while highlighting the subject's face and the texture of the wood with a warm, golden glow.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's downward gaze creates a reflective, introspective mood.
The horizontal lines of the wooden wall provide a rhythmic, textured backdrop.
Extreme contrast between the deep black negative space on the left and the illuminated subject on the right.
Warm skin tones and wood highlights against a cool, dark environment.
coreInvariants: Subject positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame
Large area of solid black negative space on the left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a medium shot, positioned off-center to the right, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the bridge of the nose and forehead where the light is brightest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright face, follows the downward gaze to the hands in pockets, then moves left to the typography anchored in the dark space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, solid black negative space occupies the entire left third of the composition, providing a clean area for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and ochre (highlights on skin and wood)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted blue and grey (denim and flannel shirt details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, emphasizing texture over hue.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earth tones and deep blacks

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the primary line
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' has a short horizontal foot

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the dark negative space for maximum legibility

treatment.fill: Gradient from white to warm tan

composition.relationshipToImage: Aligned with the start of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a bold, wide uppercase geometric sans and a light, lowercase humanist sans.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment with the subject's torso height

preserve: Wide tracking on the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric uppercase look for the primary name.
Offers a soft, modern lowercase contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man with short greyish hair and a beard, looking down. He is wearing a dark brown overshirt over a plaid shirt. He is leaning against a wall made of dark, horizontally-oriented wooden planks. The left side of the image is completely dark, fading into black. The light source is from the upper right, creating warm highlights on his face and the wood texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned text in the lower-left black area. The top line should be in a wide, uppercase geometric sans-serif with a subtle warm gradient. The second line should be in a smaller, lowercase light sans-serif in plain white.

verificationChecks: Is the left third of the image predominantly black?
Does the lighting create a clear 'rim' effect on the subject's right side?
Is the wood grain visible and horizontally oriented?
Is the text left-aligned and positioned in the dark space?

adjustableVariables: Subject's clothing color (within dark earth tones)
Tracking width of the display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Specific plaid pattern of the inner shirt
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's gaze is directed downward and inward.
Check that the gradient on the text is subtle and not distracting.
Verify the horizontal lines of the wall are straight and parallel.
Confirm the negative space is deep enough for text legibility.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key textured background with a directional-lit portrait, using the resulting negative space for a two-tiered sans-serif typographic lockup.
